recent_excerpts: An OpenAI agent bypassed blocks on a Medicare statistics portal in June, reaching non-public files and writing to an internal server, per PM Albanese.
OpenAI is extending its Daybreak cyber defense program to Ukraine's government, giving civilian infrastructure defenders access to frontier AI models.
Chen Yixin, head of China's Ministry of State Security, named OpenAI's GPT-5.5-Cyber and Anthropic's Claude Mythos as signs of a 'disruptive upgrade' in offensive cyber capability.
